verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents an official MCP server that lets LLMs work directly with its API and docs. The docs name Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Claude Desktop as supported agents, and the Claude Code/Codex plugins bundle a hosted MCP server that connects after one OAuth sign-in. missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server working in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Appwrite offers a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows LLMs to directly interact with Appwrite's API and docs.
Using the MCP server, you can use applications such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and others to operate on your Appwrite project
The Appwrite plugins for Claude Code and Codex now include the hosted Appwrite MCP server, so your agent can work with your Appwrite project after one OAuth sign-in.
